hotel_name: The Langham, New York, Fifth Avenue

claims.text: The hotel is a couple of blocks from the Empire State Building.

findings.quote: Just a couple blocks from the Empire State Building

claims.text: Bryant Park and Grand Central Station are several blocks north of the hotel, and the restaurants of Koreatown are just to the south.

findings.quote: Bryant Park and Grand Central Station several blocks to the north, the Empire State Building and the restaurants of Koreatown just to the south

claims.text: The original architects of the building were Gwathmey Siegel.

findings.quote: Gwathmey Siegel — the original architects of The Langham, New York, Fifth Avenue

claims.text: The hotel was built as The Setai Fifth Avenue in 2010 and joined the Langham Hotels and Resorts collection in 2013.

findings.quote: Originally built as The Setai Fifth Avenue back in 2010, the hotel became part of the Hong Kong-based Langham Hotels and Resorts collection in 2013

claims.text: Two large oil paintings by New York painter Alex Katz hang behind the front desk and are the first in a collection of original artworks displayed throughout the hotel.

findings.quote: you'll notice two massive oil paintings behind the front desk.
Both are by famed New York painter Alex Katz, and are the first in what has become a collection of 10 original artworks displayed throughout the hotel.

claims.text: The restaurant Ai Fiori serves French- and Italian Riviera-influenced cuisine on the hotel's second floor.

findings.quote: Ai Fiori treats diners to elevated French- and Italian Riviera-influenced cuisine from its perch on the hotel

claims.text: Rooms and suites have DUXIANA mattresses and views of the New York City skyline.

findings.quote: Featuring stunning views of the New York City skyline and exclusive DUXIANA mattresses

claims.text: The one-bedroom suites have a washer and dryer, a kitchen with a full fridge, and Empire State Building views.

findings.quote: the 14 one-bedrooms suites, all of which have a washer and dryer, extensive closet space, a kitchen (with a full fridge), an extra half-bathroom, and Empire State Building views

claims.text: The Family Room has a large walk-in closet, an oversized marble-clad bathroom and floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Fifth Avenue and Midtown Manhattan.

findings.quote: Relax with your loved ones in our spacious Family Room, featuring a large walk-in closet, oversized marble-clad bathroom, and floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Fifth Avenue and Midtown Manhattan.

claims.text: The Langham Club is on the 4th floor and overlooks Fifth Avenue.

findings.quote: The new Langham Club, located on the 4th floor and overlooking Fifth Avenue

claims.text: The gym has Technogym equipment and weights, a stretching area and on-demand classes.

findings.quote: Visit the gym for an array of Technogym equipment and weights, as well as an area for stretching and on-demand classes.

claims.text: There is elevator access to all floors and multiple ADA rooms are available.

findings.quote: There is elevator access to all floors, and multiple ADA rooms are available.
